newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GRAFOBAL'S Q1 NET PROFIT, SALES CLIMB.
newsitem.headline: GRAFOBAL'S Q1 NET PROFIT, SALES CLIMB.

text.p: Lithuanian paper producer Grafobal said on Friday that its first quarter 1997 net profit rose to 155,600 litas compared to 21,600 litas in the same period last year and that its sales had almost doubled.
"Our profit during the first three months of the year was 155,600 litas," the director general of the company, Stanislovas Jurkuvenas, told Reuters.
"We suceeded in boosting our sales to 6.5 million litas in the first quarter compared to 3.3 million litas in the same period last year," Jurkuvenas added.
The company exports 38 percent of its products.
" Our intensive work in the markets of Belarus and Latvia resulted in higher sales," Jurkuvenas said.
Grafobal is over 50 percent Slovak-owned and is quoted on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
